summary: Bug-fix verification for React 'TypeError: destroy is not a function'. Verified all 8 backend endpoints return 200 and completed full sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Transactions, Statements, Accounts, Sites, Categories, Rules, Reports, Backup & restore, Settings) plus 3x round-trip Dashboard<->Accounts. No page errors and no 'destroy is not a function' errors captured in browser console. Sample data (HDFC/SBI accounts, Green Valley/Sunshine Apartment sites, Cement/Diesel categories, 20 transaction rows) is intact.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on initial mount. Not related to this bug fix, but consider setting an explicit minHeight on the chart wrapper.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a single ~44-line minified-style file with very long lines; readability is poor. Consider splitting components (Dashboard, Transactions, Statements, MasterList, Rules, Reports, SettingsPage) into separate files.
Reports useEffect depends on `month` and re-fires on change — correctly returns void now; keep pattern consistent everywhere.
Statements load() returns Promise but is invoked from useEffect via block form — OK. Ensure future edits do NOT switch back to implicit-return arrows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is now no-auth SQLite local ledger (previous iteration tested a MongoDB+auth build and is obsolete). Public URL from frontend/.env used. Bug fix for useEffect implicit-Promise return verified across every sidebar route.
rca of the issue: React 18 treats any truthy return value from a useEffect callback as a cleanup function and later invokes it on unmount. The affected effects were arrow functions with implicit returns of `api.get(...).then(...)` / `Promise.all([...]).then(...)`, which return a Promise. On unmount React invoked `promise()` and threw 'TypeError: destroy is not a function'. Fix wraps the body in braces `{ ... }` so the effect returns undefined. Verified across MasterList (Accounts/Sites/Categories), Rules, Reports, SettingsPage, Transactions, Statements.
